objective: Reduce TAI time-to-first-useful-answer without lowering model or answer quality, and make same-conversation follow-ups reliably resolve against the newest relevant dialogue context.
required: Preserve the current local Qwen model identity, quantization, answer-quality requirements, safety boundaries, RU/EN/ZH support and read-only authority.
Replace synthetic post-completion token chunking with end-to-end model streaming or a bounded validated streaming path so useful answer text reaches the browser before full generation completes.

Never stream unvalidated secrets, prohibited write claims, private data or unsupported current-value claims; use a small sentence or semantic-block validation buffer where full raw-token passthrough would weaken safety.
Keep output-length capability and semantic completeness; do not improve latency by lowering answer quality, shrinking the model, disabling grounding or weakening completeness checks.
Fix bounded history retention so newest valid turns cannot be evicted by older long turns when the history character budget is reached.

Build a relevance-preserving conversation context from the newest turns plus compact structured subject/entities/constraints/unresolved-reference state instead of blindly replaying the largest possible raw history.
Resolve pronouns, ellipsis and continuation prompts against the immediately preceding user and assistant turns in the same conversation.
A new-chat/reset action must clear conversation context; no context may leak across tabs, sessions, users, tenants or organizations.
Public conversation context remains semantic-only and cannot grant data or authority. Authenticated context remains server-authoritative for role, tenant and accessible objects.
Instrument time-to-first-useful-token, total latency, prompt tokens, completion tokens, queue time and model time without logging raw secrets or private content.
Add warm-runtime latency acceptance and a follow-up continuity corpus in RU/EN/ZH plus mobile Chromium acceptance.
Re-run exact-main REG.RU activation/deployment/postflight and prove no semantic-quality or safety regression before production PASS.
forbidden: Smaller or lower-quality model solely for latency
Lower max output length solely for latency
Disabling grounding, provenance, safety or completeness checks
Client-authoritative role, tenant, organization, Deal or permission context
Raw model-token passthrough that can expose content before required safety checks

acceptance.quality: No regression on the existing semantic, agro-wide, disease-completeness, safety, RU/EN/ZH and exact-model-identity gates.
acceptance.continuity: Follow-up prompts using pronouns, ellipsis, comparison and omitted subjects resolve against the newest relevant turns in the same chat, while a clearly new full question is not contaminated by the previous topic.
acceptance.latency: Measure baseline and candidate on the same warm REG.RU runtime and fixed prompt corpus; candidate must reduce median time-to-first-useful-answer by at least 70% and must not worsen accepted-answer quality. Absolute warm-runtime SLOs are to be recorded from evidence rather than fabricated in advance.
acceptance.isolation: New chat/reset, another tab/session and another authenticated principal do not inherit the previous conversation context.
acceptance.production: Exact-SHA REG.RU release, live RU/EN/ZH streaming, mobile Chromium, rollback and immutable evidence PASS.
